failure.crashed_body: Reload opens the page again. Anything typed into a form on it is gone.
failure.hung_body: Wait for it, or reload it. Reloading loses anything typed into a form on it.
failure.browser_gone_body: Restart Visus to open your tabs again.
failure.runtime_missing_body: It is a 2 MB download from Microsoft. nth installs it when you say so.
failure.runtime_too_old_title: Visus needs a newer WebView2 runtime.
failure.runtime_too_old_body: Update it from Microsoft, then open Visus again.
failure.runtime_installing_body: nth is getting it from Microsoft. This takes a moment.
failure.runtime_install_failed_title: The WebView2 runtime did not install.
failure.runtime_update_failed_title: The WebView2 runtime did not update.
failure.reloads_stopped_body: It stopped working 3 times in 5 minutes, so nth no longer reloads it by itself.
failure.reason_offline: nth could not reach Microsoft. Check your connection and try again.
failure.reason_download_failed: The download from Microsoft did not finish. Try again in a moment.
failure.reason_not_signed: The file did not pass the signature check, so nth did not run it.
failure.reason_could_not_start: Windows would not start Microsoft's installer. A security setting may be blocking it.
failure.reason_installer_failed: Microsoft's installer stopped before it finished. Try again, or install it from Microsoft's page.
failure.reason_timed_out: The install is taking too long, so nth stopped waiting. Try again, or install it from Microsoft's page.
failure.reason_still_missing: The installer finished, but Windows still reports no WebView2 runtime. Try again, or install it from Microsoft's page.
failure.reason_still_too_old: The runtime is still version {0}. If your organization controls updates, ask them to update the WebView2 runtime.
